_note: C4 Model, used for structural nesting rules across ALL domains, not domain-specific (ARCHITEQ Decomposition Engine spec, section 2.2). Fixes the nesting depth for every domain to exactly these 4 levels, always in this order -- the Decomposition Engine must not introduce intermediate levels beyond this structure. Variable is Level 4's own parameters, not a 5th level.

levels.name: Context
levels.maps_to: The domain itself (e.g. "RAG system") -- single node, no internals shown

levels.name: Component
levels.maps_to: Sub-task within a layer -- logical groupings of atomic steps

levels.name: Code
levels.maps_to: Atomic step -- one-to-one with a function or n8n node
